title: S'porean man, 41, let late lawyer M Ravi consume meth at his flat, gets 2 years & 5 months' jail
text:
S'porean man, 41, let late lawyer M Ravi consume meth at his flat, gets 2 years & 5 months' jail - Mothership.SG - News from Singapore, Asia and around the world

 S'porean man, 41, let late lawyer M Ravi consume meth at his flat, gets 2 years & 5 months' jail
 They took drugs together on Dec. 24, 2025.
 Gracia Yap 
 November 16, 2026, 12:24 PM
Photos via Canva, M. Ravi Law
 A 41-year-old Singaporean man was sentenced on Nov. 16 to two years and five months' jail after he allowed former lawyer and political candidate M Ravi to consume methamphetamine at his flat. 
 CNA reported that Shawn Loo Zhi Jian pleaded guilty to three charges, including drug consumption, allowing his flat to be used for drug consumption and obstruction of justice. 
 Another two charges were taken into consideration during sentencing. 
 Took drugs together
 Charge sheets and court documents seen by Mothership stated that at about 1am on Dec. 24, 2025, Loo allowed Ravi, 56, to enter his home at Block 5A Upper Boon Keng Road. 
 The pair then consumed drugs together, after which Ravi passed out in the toilet. 
 He was conveyed to the hospital, where he was later pronounced dead. 
 His cause of death was determined to be gamma hydroxybutyric acid and methamphetamine toxicity. 
 Urine samples
 Following his arrest on Dec. 24, 2025, at about 12:10 pm, Loo provided two bottles of his urine sample. 
 According to court documents, both samples were found to contain methamphetamine. 
 Loo also admitted to consuming "ice", which is a street name for methamphetamine. 
 He had last smoked "ice" before Ravi collapsed in the unit, and would consume "ice" by using an improvised smoking apparatus. 
 Court documents stated that Loo, who smoked "ice" daily, was first exposed to it sometime in 2012 or 2013, due to curiosity. 
 He would buy his supply of "ice" from an unamed man who would deliver it to his house, where one packet cost S$500. 
 He also performed a factory reset of his mobile phone, so that the police would not investigate him for drug-related or other offences. 
 Urgent case on Christmas Eve
 An earlier report mentioned that the Singapore Police Force said in response to media queries that they were called to attend to an urgent case in an apartment at 5:41am on Christmas Eve. 
 The Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) paramedics attended to Ravi. 
 Court documents stated that while resuscitation efforts were ongoing, Loo intentionally disposed of a packet of "ice", by throwing it into the toilet bowl. 
 He also poured part of the remaining bottle of gamma butyrolactone into the sink and added water to the bottle. 
 Ravi was admitted unconscious to Tan Tock Seng Hospital, where he was subsequently pronounced dead.
